'''Vori vori''' is a thick, yellowish [[soup]] with little balls made of [[maize flour|corn flour]] and [[cheese]]. It is a traditional dish within [[Paraguayan cuisine]]. It is of Cario-Guarani origin. It has been recognized by [[TasteAtlas]] on three occasions, in 2023,<ref>{{Cite news |title=¡El vorí vorí es la mejor sopa del mundo! |trans-title=Vori vori is the best soup in the world! |url=https://www.abc.com.py/gastronomia/2023/12/13/declaran-el-vori-vori-como-la-mejor-sopa-del-mundo/ |date=13 August 2023 |work=[[ABC Color]] |access-date=20 March 2025 |language=es}}</ref> 2024,<ref>{{Cite news |date=August 11, 2024 |title=El vori vori se mantiene como mejor sopa del mundo en el Taste Atlas. |trans-title=Vori vori remains as best soup in the world on Taste Atlas |url=https://www.ultimahora.com/el-vorivori-se-mantiene-como-mejor-sopa-del-mundo-en-el-taste-atlas |archive-date= |access-date=September 18, 2024 |work=Ultima Hora |language=spanish}}</ref> and 2025,<ref>{{Cite news |url=https://www.lanacion.com.py/negocios/2024/12/14/eligen-al-vori-vori-como-la-mejor-sopa-del-mundo-para-el-2025/ |title=Eligen al vori vori como la mejor sopa del mundo |trans-title=Vori vori is chosen as the best soup in the world |date=14 December 2024 |work=La Nación |access-date=20 March 2025 |language=es}}</ref> as the most prestigious soup worldwide.

The name "vorí vorí" comes from the [[Guarani language]]. In Guarani, one way of specifying abundance is by the repetition of a word. Therefore, "vorí vorí" means many. The word "vorí", a deformation of the Spanish word "bolita" (meaning little ball). The word passed into Guarani as "borita", (as there is no phoneme L in Guarani) and finally shortened to "vorí". Thus, the literal meaning of vori vori is "plenty of little balls".
